    What fireSense_burn needs to add the year effect on the linear predictor of a power-law or Richards fit

    powerLawParsOf.Rd

    A fit made with spreadLink = "powerLaw", "powerLawSmooth" or "richards" adds its year effect (yearSpreadSD) to the linear predictor x, not to the logit of p. fireSense_burn adds the effect to x and maps back with the link (fireSenseUtils::linearLinkProb()), with these parameters.

    powerLawParsOf(
  params,
  powerLawGamma = NULL,
  lowerSpreadProb,
  powerLawShape = fireSenseUtils::spreadPowerLawShape,
  link = if (!is.null(powerLawGamma)) "powerLaw",
  lowerAsymptote = fireSenseUtils::spreadProbFloor,
  richardsNu = fireSenseUtils::spreadRichardsNu
)

    Arguments

    params

    one-row data.frame: the parameter set in use (paramSetForRep()); maxAsymptote is pc.

    powerLawGamma

    the row's gamma (ledgerPowerLawGamma()); NULL for a link without one.

    lowerSpreadProb

    the floor.

    powerLawShape

    the row's shape (ledgerPowerLawShape()).

    link

    the row's link (ledgerLinkArgs()); by default "powerLaw" when powerLawGamma is given.

    lowerAsymptote, richardsNu

    the row's lowerAsymptote and richardsNu.

    Value

    A named numeric vector (fireSenseUtils::spreadLinkParNames of the link; fireSenseUtils::linearLinkPars()), or NULL for another link.
